steps.title: Copy
steps.description: Copy Markdown from any editor or app.

steps.title: Render
steps.description: Press the global shortcut. md2png works locally in the background.

steps.title: Paste
steps.description: Paste the PNG, review it, then send it yourself.

items.label: STYLE
items.title: Five themes. Three widths.
items.description: Choose a palette and a Compact, Standard, or Wide canvas. Your choices stay local and are captured in every opaque PNG.

items.label: PREVIEW
items.title: Inspect before you share.
items.description: Preview at actual size or fit-to-window, zoom in, copy again, save explicitly, open in Apple Preview, or drag the PNG into another app.

items.label: FILES
items.title: Markdown files are welcome too.
items.description: Choose a local file, use Finder’s Open With command, or invoke its Service. Successful Finder renders open in Preview without changing the clipboard.

items.label: LONG FORM
items.title: Long documents have a safe fallback.
items.description: If one image exceeds the height limit, export numbered PNG slices. md2png prefers block boundaries and never overwrites an existing export folder.

items.summary: What if macOS shows a security prompt?
items.body: A standard first-open confirmation is expected for downloaded apps. If macOS says the app cannot be verified, delete that copy and download the notarized DMG again from the official Releases page.

items.summary: How do updates and uninstalling work?
items.body: Updates never start automatically. In About md2png, choose Check for Updates to preview signed release notes, then explicitly download, verify, and install the update. A notarized DMG remains available as a fallback. To uninstall, quit the app and move it from Applications to Trash; md2png does not keep a render history.

text.hero_lede: Turn tables, highlighted code, and Mermaid diagrams into a crisp image—without uploading your content or sending anything for you.

text.features_title: Shape the output, then use it your way.
text.showcase_body: Some chat apps flatten the parts of Markdown that matter most. md2png preserves the visual hierarchy in a Retina-friendly image that looks consistent on desktop and mobile.

text.privacy_title: Your clipboard stays on your Mac.
text.privacy_body: Rendering uses a non-persistent local WebKit view with bundled scripts and styles. There is no cloud service, analytics, telemetry, account, bot, or destination-app integration.
text.install_title: Three steps, then it stays out of your way.
text.install_body: The current release is Developer ID–signed and Apple-notarized for Apple silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later.
text.final_title: Make your next Markdown message easy to read.
